'''Netherrack''' is a {{Common}} collection item found primarily on the [[Crimson Isle]]. It gives {{Green|+0.5}} {{skl|mining}} experience when mined.

== Collection ==
Collecting netherracks increases the player's netherrack [[Collections|collection]], which grants useful items and perks upon collecting certain amounts of netherracks.

{{/Collection UI}}

{{CollectionTable|Netherrack}}

=== Kuudra Follower Boots ===
{{Item|Kuudra Follower Boots}} requires {{Green|1,000,000}} in Netherrack Collection and {{Item|Enchanted Netherrack|amount=1024}} to be given to {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Loremaster}} to claim the boots.

== Trivia ==
* [[Enchantments#Smelting Touch|Smelting Touch]] [[Pickaxes]] / [[Drills]] will automatically smelt the netherrack into {{Item|Nether Brick}}. This will not count towards the collection, so the player must use a tool without smelting touch.
* '''Netherrack''' used to be one of the hardest collections to maintain at #1, although current #1 on leaderboard<ref>[https://skyblock.matdoes.dev/leaderboards/collection_netherrack]</ref> {{RN|mvp+|niqhta}} [https://sky.shiiyu.moe/stats/niqhta/Lemon#Collections] has almost double the amount of #2.
* Netherrack is one of the only collections that does not have a [[Minions|Minion]], the others being [[Gemstone]], [[Magmafish]], [[Sulphur]] and [[Ink Sac]].
**Since there is no [[minion]] for {{Item|Netherrack}}, the most efficient way to collect is to equip {{Item|Snail Pet}} as well as wear {{Item|Rancher's Boots}} and other [[Mineral Armor]] pieces.
*Prior to the Nether update's release, players were able to access the [[Blazing Fortress]] as early as [[Combat]] Level V. Notably, those on the [[Ironman]] gamemode could quickly reach netherrack collection V and unlock the recipe for the [[Magical Lava Bucket]].
*'''Netherrack''' can be stored in 3 different sacks ([[Nether Sack]], [[Lava Fishing Sack]] and [[Mining Sack]]) which is more than any other resource, except for {{Item|Magma Cream}}, which can also be stored in 3 sacks.
